identification: Framed black and white etching of a stylised man's face with cigarette, marked AP at lower left, pencil signature lower right. Enlarged crop appears to show a stacked two-line signature (PRO over HART), the same layout seen on a Gowans A.P. Pro Hart etching, but resolution is too low to be sure. Image about 14 x 11 cm in a gilt frame with mat, under glass. Pencilled '5000/' beside it looks like a former price or stock mark. Subject is unusual for Pro Hart but he did make small figurative AP etchings, so a genuine Pro Hart is plausible, not proven.

viewing_check: Look at the signature under glass or out of the frame: is it stacked PRO / HART in pencil, and does it match known Pro Hart signatures? Check for plate title or edition number, any gallery label or certificate on the back, and the AP margin marking. If genuine, comparable small AP etchings hammer about $130-$250; if signature is not Pro Hart, it is a decorative print worth little.
